subject: Your 3-minute meeting routine
preview_text: The one habit that makes Smart Notes 10x more effective — and takes less time than your coffee
body_paragraphs: You know that feeling when you walk out of a meeting and already can't remember who said what? I've been there too many times. But here's the thing — the people who get the most out of Smart Notes don't use it all day. They use it for exactly 3 minutes after each meeting.

I tested this with a group of founders and students. The ones who opened the app right after a call — before they checked their inbox or Slack — never missed a single action item. They built a habit loop: meeting ends, open Smart Notes, review your summary. That's it. No extra work, no rewriting. Just clarity in under 180 seconds.

Here's the part that surprised me: the app's one-tap recording syncs with your calendar automatically, so your summary is ready the moment you hit 'end meeting.' And with language-aware transcription, even your bilingual calls get captured cleanly. You don't need to remember anything — the app does it for you.

Try it today: after your next meeting, open Smart Notes, check your summary, and forward it to your team. That's the routine. P.S. Premium users get unlimited summaries and priority transcription — if you're in back-to-back meetings, it's a game-changer.
